comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Passing into a community shows its name on a road-sign-style HUD popup. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon projected into world space at load (same pipeline as landmarks.json). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world metres. Entries marked needs_owner_review require the owner's lived knowledge to confirm name, boundary placement, or both.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway into Kingston — Windward Road begins here at the foot of the Palisadoes

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Entering Kingston proper along the eastern waterfront

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hills above eastern Kingston, between Mountain View Avenue and the harbour

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Community along Mountain View Avenue — National Stadium area

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Historic crossroads of Kingston — the clock tower marks the centre

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former capital of Jamaica — Cathedral of St James, Emancipation Square

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Town at the entrance to the Bog Walk Gorge, Rio Cobre river valley

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: One-lane historic bridge at the narrowest point of the gorge — landmark, not a town

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town — famous for the folk song 'Linstead Market'

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small town on the Linstead-Moneague road, bauxite industry area

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads town in the central highlands

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Iconic roadside cookshop stop — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Alexandria
communities.note: Small community between Faith's Pen and Fern Gully

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Spectacular natural canopy of tree ferns and bamboo through a river valley — A3 highway

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: North coast resort town — journey's end, Dunn's River Falls
